sources.title: GitHub - aitorDiezMateo/News2StockPredictor
sources.snippet: Overview News2Stock studies whether the text of financial news — not just historical prices — carries predictive signal about how a stock will move the next day. The project frames this as a 3-class classification problem (DOWN / NEUTRAL / UP) over a rolling window of recent trading days and recent news, for seven large-cap technology stocks: AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META, NVDA, TSLA.
